findings.title: The new refusal's escalation is now durable, but a failed hold *write* still throws into the same log-only catch the fix was built to escape
findings.detail:
New residual in round 4. §2.5 line 81 routes the target-capture refusal through `return holdLandRun('land_target_snapshot_unavailable')`, and that mechanism verifies out completely: `holdWorkflowLandNode` (StateStore.ts:74276-74405) does all three writes in one transaction — `UPDATE workflow_run SET status='held' WHERE status='active'` (74361-74364), `appendWorkflowRunEventCheckedTx({eventUid: escalationUid, kind:'land_held'})` (74369-74381), and, gated on `input.alertIdentity`, `enqueueWorkflowEngineAlertTx({escalationUid, …})` (74382-74401). `operationId` is optional (74281), so the no-operation hold is natively supported. The plan is right to make `resolveRunAlertIdentity` mandatory, since the outbox row exists only when `alertIdentity` is passed.

What is still unstated is the failure of that write. `holdLandRun` (workflow-engine-dispatcher.ts:2196-2215) ends with `if (!held.ok) { throw new Error(\`engine_land_hold_${held.reason}\`); }`, and that throw propagates out of `consume` into the catch at workflow-engine-dispatcher.ts:418-425, which is still `result.held += 1; this.log(...)` — no persisted state, no alert. `holdWorkflowLandNode` can return `ok:false` on `land_hold_precondition_failed` (run no longer `active`, `current_node_id` moved, or `node.execution_id` changed — 74327-74338) and on `land_run_state_changed` (74365-74368), both reachable under concurrent reconciliation. §6 A's new bullet mandates durable-outbox assertions in tests but says nothing about runtime behaviour when the hold write itself fails, so in that race the escalation is lost to a log line — the exact class of silent loss this plan eliminates everywhere else ("投递失败不标 delivered，重启继续", §5).

Suggest one sentence in §2.5: on `holdWorkflowLandNode` returning `ok:false`, the dispatcher must re-read run/node state and either retry the hold on the next reconcile with the refreshed tuple or raise the existing project-level escalation — never let `engine_land_hold_*` be the terminal record. Noting for completeness that the same log-only catch already swallows the pre-existing `engine_land_authority_unavailable` throw at dispatcher:2239; that one is not introduced here, but the fix would cover both.
findings.failure_scenario: A target probe times out, so `prepareLandIntent` returns the typed refusal and `consume` calls `holdLandRun('land_target_snapshot_unavailable')`. Between the intent being picked up and the hold transaction, another reconcile pass advances `current_node_id`. `holdWorkflowLandNode` returns `land_hold_precondition_failed`, `holdLandRun` throws `engine_land_hold_land_hold_precondition_failed`, the catch at dispatcher:418 logs it, and the run stays active with no held row, no `land_held` event and no alert outbox entry — leaving nothing for `flywheel-comm hold list --run` to surface.

findings.title: §6 A's first RED bullet still tells the implementer to capture the snapshot via `ensureLandOperation`, which round 4 moved to the new async provider
findings.detail:
Stale wording. §6 A line 136 still reads "先调用 ensureLandOperation 捕获真实 binding snapshot，再删行". After round 4, capture belongs to the new async `prepareLandIntent` provider (§2.5 line 79: "所有 git/文件 await 在 provider 中完成"), and `ensureLandOperation` keeps its synchronous SQLite transaction while gaining a *required* `verifiedTargets:{json,digest,version,attributionDigest,observedAt}` parameter — it no longer discovers anything itself, since `WorktreeManager.getRegisteredWorktree` and `readWorktreeGeneration` are async and cannot be awaited inside `this.db.transaction(...)` (StateStore.ts:71716-71760). The very next bullet (line 137) is correct and does go through the provider, so this is only an internal inconsistency — but an implementer following bullet 1 literally would build the all-rows-absent fixture through the wrong entry point and miss the provider's verification, which is the part the fixture is meant to exercise. Reword to "先经 `prepareLandIntent` 走完整 provider 验证并落库 verifiedTargets，再删行".

For the record, the rest of round 4's wiring claims check out exactly as written: `lifecycle-routes.ts:219` is a synchronous `router.post("/land", (req, res) => …)` whose handler reads `operation.operation_id` at lines 250-251 immediately after `deps.land.createIntent(...)` at 243, so the plan's "必须 await 后再 makeRunnable/kick（不能将 Promise 当 row）" is precise; `createIntent` is declared at lifecycle-routes.ts:73 and provided at plugin.ts:8433, and lifecycle-routes.ts:243 is its only call site, so the consumer set the plan wires (dispatcher:2269, plugin:8494/8537, lifecycle-routes:219) is complete; `land_held_without_operation` exists at hold-shape-registry.ts:151 with `operation: "absent"` and `requiredDecision: ["retry","terminate"]`, and `resume_land_without_operation` at StateStore.ts:49538-49546 requires `decision === "retry"` and no operation for the run; the quoted `flywheel-comm hold list/resume` flags match the CLI usage at hold.ts:26-27 verbatim; `workflow_run_event.kind='hold_resumed'` with `eventUid: hold_resumed:${shape}:${holdEventUid}` exists at StateStore.ts:49991-49992, so the recoveryEpisode dedupe key is grounded — and the problem it fixes is real: `holdWorkflowLandNode`'s `if (prior) return {ok:true, idempotentReplay:true}` at 74314-74320 returns before the `status='held'` update, so without the episode component a post-resume repeat refusal would report success while leaving the run active.
findings.failure_scenario: An implementer works the §6 A checklist top-down, builds the all-rows-absent fixture by calling `ensureLandOperation` directly with a hand-written `verifiedTargets` payload, and never exercises `prepareLandIntent`'s git-registration/generation verification or its typed-refusal path — so the RED test passes without covering the capture logic it exists to pin.
